Commentary.Commentary: England on the other hand, bowled well. They kept it nice and tight, attacked the stumps and managed to pick wickets when needed. Shrubsole and Glenn were the pick as the two took three each. Brunt and Ecclestone also finished with two. Overall, a complete performance by England.

The target is a tough one, Pakistan will have to bat really well if they are to chase this down. The ball might just skid on under lights but they will still need to bat brilliantly. England on the other hand will back themselves to defend this. Stay tuned for the second essay.

The Pakistan bowling was good to begin with and good to end with but the middle overs could cost them the game. Their spinners, who they rely on, failed to pick wickets and also let the batters score freely. Aiman Anwer and Diana Baig were the pick for them but overall it is not a performance they will be happy with.

End of a very good batting performance from England! After being inserted, they lost Jones early but Wyatt and Sciver steadied the ship. After the dismissal of Wyatt, Knight and Sciver got things going. However, when Sciver fell, Pakistan did have a chance to get back into the game but Knight ensured that did not happen. She built a good stand with Wilson and also got up her fifty. At one stage, something above 160 looked possible but the last 8 balls did not see a boundary coming and hence, they were restricted below that. Still though, they will be the happier side of the two at the moment.

Good end the innings with the ball from Pakistan. Anwer bowls one on middle, Winfield lofts it over mid on and the fielder at long on slides across in pursuit of the catch and parries the ball towards wide long on. The batters in the end up taking a couple. ENGLAND FINISH WITH 158/7!
Short and on middle, Ecclestone pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on the pads, Winfield flicks it to short fine leg for a quick single.
Length ball on off, Ecclestone pulls it over mid on for a single.

OUT! STUMPED! Brilliantly bowled from Aiman Anwer. She has been the best so far. This time bowls one outside off, Brunt comes down the track to defend it but gets beaten on the outside edge. Sidra Nawaz there takes the ball and whips the bails off in  flash.
Fuller length ball outside off, driven to wide long off for a single.
Lauren Winfield is the new woman in.
OUT! TAKEN! Two wickets in two balls for Nida to end her spell! She gets Knight this time. It is tossed up outside off. HK drags it towards long on where the fielder takes a decent catch.

In the air... dropped, no taken! OUT! Nida gets one. Beaumont comes down the track and whips it towards deep mid-wicket. Ali there gets two hands to it but it pops out. The ball though hits her knee and then lobs up again. She takes it.
FOUR! Nida has not had a good night with the ball! 150 up for England. One more full toss, TB brings out the reverse sweep and hits it through backward point for a boundary.
A full toss now, it is towards wide long on for one.
SIX! All the way! Knight comes down the track and gets to the pitch of the ball. She hits it well over the long on fence.
TB comes down the track and jams it down to long off for one.
WIDE! Down the leg side, the batter looks to sweep but misses.
Length ball on off, Beaumont looks to flick it to the leg side but closes the bat face early. It goes of the soft leading edge towards covers for a single.
Tammy Beaumont walks out to bat.
OUT! BOWLED! Slower ball around off and on a length. Wilson fails to pick that up and ends up playing the slog early. The ball crashes into the off pole now.
Length ball on off, Wilson almost gets out there. She comes down the track to play this length ball outside off but gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a couple.
On a good length and on off, Knight sweeps it through mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball on off, Wilson lofts it over mid on for a single.
DROPPED ! Another one put down. Aiman Anwer is the one now. She bowls one on off, Knight once again hits it straight the bowler fails to hold onto one and the ball goes towards mid off for a run.
A single to end as this is hit down to long on.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and connects. They pick up a single.
FOUR! 50-run stand up between the two! Wilson steps out and gets to the pitch of the ball. She hits it through mid-wicket and bags a boundary.
Just short! On the shorter side, Knight pulls, she hits it flat towards square leg where the fielder dives forward but it lands just short.
Just short! Wilson comes down the track and makes it into a full toss. She mistimes it towards deep mid-wicket but it falls short. A single taken.
A single as this is hit down to long off.
Full length ball on off, swept through mid-wicket for a run by Knight. 50 up for Heather Knight.
Length ball on off, driven to covers.
FOUR! Length ball on off, Knight is playing it brilliantly here. She enjoys batting at this ground. she waits on this length ball and cuts it through point for a boundary.

DROPPED! That is another let off. Pakistan have been poor with their catching. It is a fuller length ball on off,  Knight looks to go downtown but ends up hitting it straight to the bowler there. Baig in her followthrough gets two hands to it but the ball pops out of her hand.
Length ball on off, driven to covers.
FOUR! Length ball outside off, Knight sweeps it hard towards mid-wicket where the fielder in the deep fumbles and allows the ball to roll over the fence for a boundary.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and connects. They pick up a single.

Tossed up ball outside off, Knight shuffles across her stumps and goes for the sweep but fails to get anything behind that shot. The ball raps her on the pads. There is an appeal but the umpire is unmoved.
Floated ball on off, Wilson this time connects on the sweep and gets a a single towards mid-wicket.
Floated outside off, Knight dances down the track and chips it in the air over mid off for a single.
Bowls this one with a lot of air and Wilson who looks it sweep gets a top edge that goes over the keeper and towards fine leg for a single.
Floated wide outside off, Knight slaps it through covers for a run.
Bismah Maroof is on now!
One more single to add to the total as another ball is hit towards long off.
Just a single off the Free Hit as this is eased down to long off.
NO BALL! This one has pitched outside the pitch and hence, it has been called a no ball! Free Hit coming up. Dar under pressure.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Dropped AND FOUR! That is a huge let off! Knight, on this ground especially, is the last person you want to put down. She goes for the slog sweep, hits it up in the air towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder gets two hands to it but spills it. To add salt to the wound, it goes behind to the boundary.
Shorter and around off, this is guided towards point.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaris for England! The reverse sweep this time by Wilson. She nails it through backward square leg and the ball races to the fence.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Short and wide outside off,  Knight goes back and smashes it through covers for boundary.
One more short ball outside off, it is slapped towards cover. The batters hesitate before going for a run but then take it.
Shortish again, Wilson pulls it through mid-wicket. It is in the gap and two is taken.
Shorter in length again and outside off, it is slapped through covers for one.
Shorter in length and on middle, the batter pulls it through square leg and takes one.
Outside off, this is hit through covers for one.

DROPPED! Wilson gets a life. Sidra Nawaz who effected a brilliant stumping on the first ball of the over drops a catch on the last ball. Wilson gets a life here. It is bowled outside off, Wilson goes with hard hands and gets an outside edge towards the keeper who fails to hold onto it.
Length ball on the pads, Knight flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Brilliant timing from Knight there. Short of a length ball outside off, Knight cuts it powerfully through point and the ball races to the fence.
Full and outside off, Wilson drives it through covers for a single.
Length ball around off, Wilson punches the ball off the back foot towards point.
Length ball on off, pushed to covers.

WIDE! OUT! STUMPED! Aliya Riaz breaks the stand that blew away Thailand. Brilliantly bowled. Riaz bowls one down the leg side and Sciver who looks to flick it misses it. Sidra Nawaz behind the wickets collects it and whips the bails off. She is very confident that she has had her woman here. The square leg umpire takes it upstairs and the replays roll in to show that yes, Nawaz was spot on with her glove work.
Fran Wilson is the new woman in.
A stumping check is sent upstairs. Natalie Sciver is the one in question. Lets see what the replays have to say.
A single to end! So despite going for a boundary,  just the 6 from it. The last ball is hit down to long on.
Very full again on off, it is jammed out towards mid off.
Sciver steps out now but does not get to the pitch of the ball. It is hit towards mid off.
Shorter and outside off, it is cut through point for one.
The length is shortened on off, Knight pushes it to mid off.
FOUR! Good use of the feet. Knight comes down the track, gets to the pitch of it and lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
Full and outside off, Knight reverse sweeps it through point and gets a single.
Tossed up around off, Knight drives it straight to covers.
Full and on the pads, Sciver tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Floated ball on off, Knight drives it through mid on for a single.
Flatter and outside off, Sciver pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Floated ball on off, pushed to mid off for a single.
Nida Dar is back on!
Floats it up on off, it is driven to mid off.

FOUR! Lovely shot! This is slightly shorter and on middle, Sciver goes back and pushes it through mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep runs to her left and tries to push the ball back in but while doing so, she ends up touching the ropes. A boundary.
Very short, Knight pulls it through mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and on middle, it is pushed to mid-wicket.
This is eased down to long on for one.
On off, it is pushed through covers for one.
On a good length and on off, Knight punches the ball through covers for a single.
Length ball outside off, Knight blocks it off the back foot towards covers.
FOUR! Beautifully played. Length ball outside off, Knight opens the face of the bat and runs it down fine towards third man and gets a boundary.
Length ball outside off, Knight cuts it to point.
FOUR! Knight continues her great form! Length ball around off, Heather leans and drives through covers for boundary.
Length ball on off, punched off the back foot towards mid on for a single.
Aliya Riaz is on now!
Knight comes down the track but the bowler shortens the length. It is pushed to covers. A good over by Iqbal.
Shorter in length again and on middle, this is pushed back towards the bowler who sticks her right hand out. It hits it and goes towards long on for one.
A little too short! Sciver goes back and pulls it through square leg for two. Fifty up for England.
This is fired on middle, Sciver goes back and works it to mid-wicket.
Floats it up on off, it is driven towards mid off.
Shorter and around off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Sadia Iqbal is on now!

A single to end a very good over! This is full and outside off, it is driven towards cover. The batters go for a run. The fielder picks the ball up and fires it to the keeper but it is a little high and Sciver makes it in with a dive. Knight is off the mark.
On the fuller side and around off, Knight strokes it back to the bowler.
That stays low! On a length and around off, it stays quite low. Knight gets his bat down in time and keeps it out.
Good length and on off, kept out.
Heather Knight is the new woman in.

OUT! TAKEN! Wyatt is a goner and a welcome wicket for Pakistan! A shorter one outside off, Wyatt cuts but does so uppishly. It goes low towards point where Ali takes a simple catch. They will now look to pull back things.
On middle, it is worked towards mid-wicket for one.
Aiman Anwer is back on!
Length ball on off, Wyatt pushes it towards the off side only to get and inside edge towards square leg.
Length and on off, flicked towards mid-wicket and the batters cross for a run.
Full and on off, Wyatt gets and inside edge on the drive past the stumps towards the leg side and the batsmen pick up a single.

Good running. Baig bowls one outside off and Sciver drives it through covers. The fielder there fumbles and allows the ball to go towards the sweeper where it is pulled right inside the ropes. Three runs taken.
Length ball outside off, Sciver goes for the pull but misses it.
Length ball on leg, flicked to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Three fours from the over. Tossed up on off, Sciver drives it through covers and gets another boundary.
FOUR! Floated ball on off, Sciver drives it down the ground and beats mid off for a boundary at long off.
Tossed up on off, Sciver punches it off the back foot towards covers.
FOUR! Flatter and around off, Sciver shuffles across her stumps and scoops it over the keeper and into the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Tossed up on off, driven towards covers this time.
Floated outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Good length and on off, it is kept out. Another good over by Diana.
Well fielded! Saves three for her side! Full and around off, it is creamed towards mid off. The fielder there runs to her right, dives and gets a strong hand to it.
On middle, this is pushed towards mid on.

A huge shout but this time turned down! On a length and around middle, Wyatt looks to defend but misses to get hit high on the pads. It rolls on the off side for one. The umpire waits, sees the Pakistan players do not review and then signals the leg bye. Looked high.
On the pads, it is worked towards square leg for one run.
Good length and on off, kept out.
Well down the leg side, Sciver lets it be. Wided.
EDGY FOUR! End of a big, big over for England! Shorter and outside off, Wyatt cuts but it flies off the outside edge and down to the third man fence.
FOUR! Up and over! Wyatt makes room and this is bowled full and wide outside off. She carves it over point for another boundary.
Good length and on off, defended.
Fumble and a run! Fuller and around off, this is hit towards mid off. The fielder does not stop it cleanly and a single is taken.
Direct hit and it would have been close! On a length and around off, Wyatt guides it towards short third man and takes off. The fielder has a shy at the striker's end but misses.
WIDE! One more wide as this one too is bowled down the leg side.
WIDE! Down the leg side, it has been wided.

FOUR! That was a chance! The fielder has probably lost it in the sun. Full and wide outside off, it is carved out towards cover-point. The fielder there initially goes for the catch but then loses sight of ball. In the end it goes just wide of her and for a boundary.
Aiman Anwer to bowl from the other end.
FOUR! That is a shot from a woman in form! It is fuller and around off, Sciver strokes it on the up and through covers for a boundary.
Natalie Sciver walks out to bat.

OUT! Umpire's call and Jones has to take the long walk back! She does not take the review along though. Once again England lose an early wicket. This is a length ball around off, Jones walks down the track and looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal and up goes the finger. After a long chat, Jones reviews. Ultra Edge shows no bat and Hawk Eye shows it to be clipping the top of middle.
Jones has been given out LBW but she reviews. It could turn out to be a good review.
Jones is off the mark now with a couple! This is fuller and around off, Jones looks to stroke it through covers but it goes off the inner half through square leg for one.
Good length and on off, Jones keeps it out.
A dot from it! Jones moves right across and Diana bowls it down the leg side. Jones swings but misses. No wide as Jones had shuffled across.

England are underway! This is on a length and around off, Wyatt opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for one. now then, the third umpire has passed on a message to the on-field umpire saying it is a NO BALL! So Free Hit coming up for Jones, a freebie on the first ball she faces.
Right on the money to begin with! Full and tailing away on off, Wyatt guides it to point.

Done and dusted with the National Anthems. England openers Amy Jones and Danielle Wyatt walk in to start the innings. Pakistan players are out to in the middle. Diana Baig to start with the ball for Pakistan.
It's time for National Anthems. Players from both the teams line up for their respective National Anthems.

England (UNCHANGED Playing XI) - Amy Jones (wk), Danielle Wyatt, Heather Knight (c), Natalie Sciver, Fran Wilson, Tammy Beaumont, Lauren Winfield, Katherine Brunt, Anya Shrubsole, Sophie Ecclestone, Sarah Glenn.
Pakistan Playing XI - Javeria Khan, Muneeba Ali, Bismah Maroof (c), Nida Dar, Umaima Sohail, Iram Javed, Aliya Riaz, Sidra Nawaz (wk), Aiman Anwer, Diana Baig, Sadia Iqbal ( IN FOR Anam Amin).

England skipper, Heather Knight says that they do not find batting first, the wicket won't change a lot. They back their opening partnership, they have scored loads of runs and they will come good. The Pakistan side is a good and improved one and they are up for the challenge.

Pakistan skipper, Bismah Maroof says, it seems a good wicket and the ball comes on nicely under lights. They need to put pressure on England and then capitalize on that and they need to stick to their strength. They are confident heading into this game.
TOSS - It's time for the flip of the coin. It lands in the favour of Bismah Maroof. PAKISTAN OPT TO BOWL!

Time for the second game of today's double-header. England take on Pakistan. Both teams are coming on the back of victories. England thumped Thailand and Pakistan thrashed West Indies. Both teams today will look to get the two points up for grabs and get closer to qualifying for semi final. Toss and teams coming up shortly.
